candidate.definition_en: A doctor who is qualified to perform surgery (operations).
candidate.explanation_ar: الدكتور المتخصص اللي بيعمل عمليات جراحية للمرضى.

senses.definition_en: A doctor who is qualified to perform surgery (operations).
senses.explanation_ar: الدكتور المتخصص اللي بيعمل عمليات جراحية للمرضى.

examples: The surgeon washed his hands before the operation.
The heart surgeon performed a complex transplant.
I want to be a surgeon when I grow up.
candidate.mnemonic: 'Surgeon' قريبة من 'Sir'.. هو 'Sir' في أوضة العمليات.. أو 'Surgeon' بيعمل 'Surgery'.
